purpose: Keep validation labels, metrics and claim boundaries consistent across the manuscript, audit and LLM grounding.

scope_manifest_verification.claim_boundary: Metadata and artifact-integrity audit only; no private rows are published and no full-loop or human-effectiveness claim is created.

includes: station-side HRS process and safety digital-twin behavior
release, dispersion, consequence and risk-model component checks
direct-answer SAGA generation with explicit evidence boundaries
excludes: vehicle-side controller and ESD channel validation

lanes.label: same_site_station_side_time_ordered_holdout
lanes.claim_boundary: Same-site station-side pressure, cascade and short-horizon recharge diagnostics only; this is not independent external validation and does not support vehicle, field-safety, certification or SAGA-effectiveness claims.

lanes.label: independent_external_component_holdout
lanes.claim_boundary: Independent external receiving-tank thermodynamic component evidence only; it does not validate station control, cascade topology, dispenser, vehicle channels, ESD sequence or field safety.

lanes.label: prospective_external_ignited_pressure_peaking_component
lanes.claim_boundary: Actual-hydrogen ignited pressure-peaking consequence submodel only; not an H70 outdoor station, fueling loop, jet-radiation, emergency-control or SAGA-effectiveness validation.

lanes.label: prospective_external_unignited_pressure_peaking_screen
lanes.claim_boundary: Retain as exploratory confined-vented enclosure evidence; do not present as confirmatory validation or as full-loop station evidence.

lanes.label: public_actual_incident_action_to_playbook_traceability
lanes.claim_boundary: Public actual-incident action categories are traceably routed to staged simulator playbooks. This does not judge whether the historical action was correct, validate physics, estimate incident probability, or demonstrate SAGA/operator safety effectiveness.

station_to_vehicle.paper_limitation: No openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified; vehicle-side controller/ESD and complete full-loop field validation remain outside the claim boundary.
station_to_vehicle.reentry_condition: Only a custodian-provided, de-identified, synchronized trace frozen before outcome access can reopen this lane.

human_saga_effectiveness.paper_boundary: Do not claim improved operator safety, response time, decision accuracy or deployment readiness until an institutional determination and independent blinded expert review are complete.

interpretation.independent_external_validation_scope: public Type-IV component plus actual-hydrogen ignited consequence component; not full-loop
do_not_conflate: same-site holdout with independent external validation
